title: Reports & Insights editorial treatment
changes: Reports landing hero and section bands now use the Wave 7 semantic editorial palette.
Lead, card and carousel report teasers share consistent paper/deep-green surfaces, gold accents and restrained elevation.
Report articles use the shared reading measure for long-form content while preserving wide local table behavior.
The report synthesis, analysis, stat, methodology, related-record and source treatments now form one evidence-forward editorial hierarchy.
Back navigation now preserves the 44px interaction baseline.
preserved: Report data, headlines, synthesis and analysis text
Inline evidence identifiers and source links
Tables, charts and civic relationship links
